source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Identify the date, time, and location of the accident.
3. Document the names, positions, and contact details of all involved employees, witnesses, supervisors, and medical responders if applicable.
4. Describe in detail the sequence of events leading up to the accident.
5. Note whether any equipment was involved and its condition prior to the accident.
6. Identify any hazardous or unsafe conditions at the site that might have contributed to the accident.
7. Include details about any personal protective equipment (PPE) in use or missing at the time of the accident.
8. Record the type and severity of any injuries sustained, and detail any medical treatment provided to victims, whether on-site or in a healthcare facility.
9. Photograph the accident location if possible, including any equipment or conditions implicated in the accident.
10. Get written statements from witnesses that provide their perspective on the events.
11. Describe what measures were taken immediately after the accident, such as first aid
